description: Write a working starter widget (manifest, HTML, CSS, JS showing live CPU and memory) into a new or empty folder. Edit it from there, then install_widget.

folder.description: Absolute path of the widget folder (the one holding manifest.json). Its name is the widget id unless `id` is given.

id.description: Widget id: 2 to 41 characters, a-z, 0-9 and dashes.

name.description: The name people see. Defaults to the id.

overwrite.description: Replace files with the same names in a folder that is not empty.

name: new_widget
